description: This file defines a C++ header for the 'Format' structure used in the ANGLE project to query and manage texture format information for Direct3D 11 rendering, including format mappings and device capabilities.

classes.name: Format
classes.description: A structure representing the mapping between OpenGL internal formats and Direct3D 11 formats, including format identifiers and initialization functions.

methods.name: Format()
methods.description: Default constructor initializing format fields to unknown or null values.

methods.name: Format(GLenum internalFormat, angle::FormatID formatID, DXGI_FORMAT texFormat, DXGI_FORMAT srvFormat, DXGI_FORMAT uavFormat, DXGI_FORMAT rtvFormat, DXGI_FORMAT dsvFormat, DXGI_FORMAT blitSRVFormat, GLenum swizzleFormat, InitializeTextureDataFunction internalFormatInitializer)
methods.description: Parameterized constructor to initialize all format mappings and related data.

methods.name: Get(GLenum internalFormat, const Renderer11DeviceCaps &deviceCaps)
methods.description: Static method to retrieve format information based on internal format and device capabilities.

methods.name: getSwizzleFormat(const Renderer11DeviceCaps &deviceCaps) const
methods.description: Returns the swizzle format for the current format, considering device capabilities.

methods.name: getLoadFunctions() const
methods.description: Returns load functions associated with the format.

methods.name: format() const
methods.description: Returns the angle::Format object associated with this format.
